items.title: Abyssal Lapidary is making the social media rounds and I can confirm cutting gemstones is just as satisfying as it looks
items.summary: I'm a chump who can't tell my gems from my minerals.
items.body: I have never really thought much about gemstones or minerals, which is weird considering one of my all-time favourite games is Minecraft, in which I spend a bulk of my time strip-mining. But Abyssal Lapidary has made me realise that there is so much more to the dirt than just coal. In the demo for Abyssal Lapidary I got to begin my stint as a lapidarist, someone who cuts, shapes, grinds, and polishes minerals to make pretty gemstones. The only problem is, like I said before, I don't really know stones. (Image credit: LightWorm) Abyssal Lapidary doesn't exactly drop you in the deep end but it does expect you to pick up with the art of making and selling gemstones rather quickly. My first step was searching around the rather large house I'd found myself in which was apparently part of a declining business but it seemed rather nice; it even had a balcony. Most of the doors downstairs were locked, part of the later progression of the game, the few things I did have access to included a station for fixing tools, breaking rocks, and a booth to talk to customers. Throughout the day people will turn up to my humble business either looking to buy some precious gemstones or selling minerals…

items.title: AMD says the re-release of the Ryzen 7 5800X3D was 'like a final gift to our loyal [AM4] users' and it was CEO Dr. Lisa Su who first came up with the idea
items.summary: It timed itself rather nicely with the deepening memory crisis, too.
items.body: I was genuinely surprised by the re-release of the AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D earlier this year. A chip I thought long dead was back in 10th Anniversary form, after a resurrection process AMD's David McAfee described as " very hard, actually " to our Dave at Computex 2026. Now AMD's Travis Kirsch has spoken to Japanese outlet Tech+ about more of the thinking behind the re-release, and it seems the idea started at the very top. "Originally, several years ago, I believe Lisa [Su, AMD CEO] was one of the people who suggested reviving the Ryzen 7 5800X3D." "It was like a final gift to our loyal users who had used our AM4 for almost 10 years, giving them one last chance to upgrade their PCs using DDR4 systems," Kirsch continues. "However, this required restarting the production lines, which took some time. In short, this was planned before the changes in the memory market occurred, and it was not considered as a solution to the DDR5 shortage." That may be the case, but the timing still worked out pretty well for AMD. items.body: Whether you dismiss it as 'fake frames' or embrace the tech as a real game changer, frame generation has fast become a headlining act of this GPU generation. We've since discovered that not all frame gen (FG) tech is created equal, but AMD has promised to address a key criticism of its own FSR FG. Earlier this week, AMD's Jack Huynh announced that FSR 4.1 would be shipping early to RX 6000 graphics cards , though that wasn't all. Huynh also announced that improvements to FSR's frame pacing were on the way, too . Personally, I'm more familiar with Nvidia's approach to FG—especially after unlocking Multi Frame Gen on my RTX 4070 Super earlier this year. AMD's FSR has often been criticised for how it struggles with frame pacing in comparison. Ie, you may have lots of frames , but not every one of them is displayed for a consistent amount of time, making for gameplay that's a different flavour of choppy. The issue can affect frames both traditionally rendered and generated, and it's been a stumbling block since at least FSR 3. items.title: برقم مثير.. الحمدان يصنع الحدث مع النصر
items.summary: نجم العالمي يحقق رقمًا مميزًا
items.body: نجم العالمي يحقق رقمًا مميزًا منح عبدالله الحمدان، مهاجم النصر، فريقه بداية مثالية أمام الفيصلي، بعدما نجح في هز الشباك خلال الدقائق الأولى من المواجهة التي تجمع الفريقين ضمن منافسات الجولة الحادية عشرة من دوري روشن السعودي للمحترفين. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وجاء هدف الحمدان في الدقيقة الرابعة، ليمنح النصر أفضلية مبكرة في اللقاء، ويترجم ثقة المدرب الأسترالي آنج بوستيكوجلو، الذي قرر الاعتماد عليه أساسيًا في التشكيلة، بدلًا من البرازيلي أنجيلو جابرييل. ووفقًا لشبكة " أوبتا " للإحصائيات، سجّل الحمدان أسرع أهدافه في مسيرته بدوري المحترفين السعودي، كما رفع رصيده إلى ثلاثة أهداف خلال الموسم الحالي، معادلًا أفضل حصيلة تهديفية له في موسم واحد بالمسابقة. وسبق للمهاجم السعودي تسجيل ثلاثة أهداف في أربعة مواسم مختلفة، هي 2019-2020 و2020-2021 و2023-2024 و2025-2026، ليكرر إنجازه التهديفي في الموسم الجاري، مع امتلاكه فرصة الانفراد بأفضل حصيلة شخصية له إذا واصل التسجيل خلال المباريات المقبلة. ويمنح هذا الهدف الحمدان دفعة معنوية مهمة، خصوصًا أنه جاء في أول دقائق المباراة التي حصل فيها على فرصة المشاركة أساسيًا، ليؤكد قدرته على استغلال الفرص المتاحة، ويضع بوستيكوجلو أمام خيار هجومي أثبت فاعليته مبكرًا أمام الفيصلي. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشتر تذكرتك الآن!

items.title: In a rare instance of good news, Philips has announced the world's first 36-inch, 260 Hz gaming monitor. So that's nice
items.summary: Let's all look upon it with wonder.
items.body: Writing (and reading) about PC hardware news at the moment can be downright depressing. Massive price rises. AI everywhere. Disappearing graphics cards . It's just a bit much, you know? So come and bask in something deliciously old school with me: the release of a good-looking new product you might be able to buy without selling a kidney. Philips says its new 36M4C5500P display is the world's first 36-inch gaming monitor with a 260 Hz refresh rate . Lovely. This ultrawide's got a curved, 1500R VA panel. Oooooh. A 3440 x 1440 resolution. Ahhhh. And an overclockable refresh rate that makes sense for casual and competitive gamers alike. Stone the crows and call the fire department, it actually looks pretty decent. Sure, VA panel tech is nothing fancy. And many a curved ultrawide has passed the doors of PC Gamer Towers over the past few years. But a 36-inch panel size is something interesting, filling the gap between your standard 34-inch ultrawides and the more desk-dominating, 39-inch-and-up models. items.title: LG UltraGear Evo 52G930B Evo gaming monitor review
items.summary: LG's new 52-inch ultrawide 5K2K monster monitor is surprisingly old school.
items.body: Can you have too much of a mediocre thing? If I was being unkind, that's the challenge I'd make to the new LG UltraGear Evo 52G930B . What we are talking about here, people, is a monumental 52-inch 5K2K gaming monitor. But it's based on an old-school VA panel. Yep, not OLED. Not IPS. It doesn't even have mini-LED local dimming. It's just a huge, high-res, VA panel. At 52 inches, it's so big and so expensive it immediately poses another problem. Why wouldn't you just buy a 4K TV? After all, this LG clocks in at $1,699 or £1,499, which buys you an awful lot of 4K TV here in late 2026. That kind of money puts you in reach of OLED TVs up to around 65 inches. And, like I said, the LG UltraGear Evo 52G930B isn't actually that well specced save for its size and resolution. Retail graphics card pricing has already gone bananas in recent months, with US prices surging to hitherto unthinkable levels. items.summary: Asus delivers the first Wi-Fi 8 router.
items.body: We’re not surprised that Asus has delivered the first Wi-Fi 8 router. The company has been ruling the router roost recently and notably broke the 3,000 Mbps transfer-rate barrier with its AI-enhanced, ROG Rapture GT-BE19000AI Wi-Fi 7 gaming router. That’s old hat now that its functionally-identical Wi-Fi 8 sibling, the Asus ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro , is here. Or is it? Wi-Fi 8 (also known as 802.11bn) is expected to be officially ratified in late 2028. By the time you read this, at least four routers will have hit the market, but no laptops (or other devices) are in sight. But, that shouldn’t matter. We've spent some time in the last year testing top-tier Wi-Fi 7 set-ups, and seeing they can be faster than some 10 Gbps wired connections, so why do we need another Wi-Fi generation? However, unlike previous generations, Wi-Fi 8 isn’t about delivering more speed, it’s about delivering a more-reliable signal (including more-robust uploading), to new and old devices alike, in crowded Wi-Fi environments, over greater distances, in real-world environments. Better yet, the mod features new quests and over a dozen new characters voiced by real people—no AI was used! But there's something better than that , even. I was delighted to discover that the town of Detour has its own gang . It's a small gang, sure: the overpass Detour is built on isn't particularly big and the town itself is pretty tiny, so there's not a whole lot of room for different factions to spring up. items.title: I've never seen a laptop cooler come with its own comic strip before, but it still hasn't convinced me this noisy beast is worth $50
items.summary: Not so cool.
items.body: Budget Win or Recycle Bin? (Image credit: Future) Andy Edser is a man with a mission. It's a mission he didn't sign up for, or even want, but I'm his boss so he has to do what I say. And I'm making him test a ton of different cheap tech I might find on Amazon, AliExpress, TikTok Shop, or down the back of my sofa. Out of nowhere it will appear on his doorstep with no warning, and he has no choice but to use whatever it is like his life depends on it. Because it does. I find myself charmed (and perhaps a little perturbed) by the little black envelope included with this Klim Everest laptop cooling pad. Inside you get a set of shiny stickers, a warranty card, and, err.. a comic strip depicting the fictional process that begins when you order one. (Image credit: Future) Want to keep testing your knowledge of gaming trivia? We've got loads more PC Gamer quizzes , on everything from healthbars to weird currencies to absurd patch notes. That enthusiasm for terror is why I have the nervous system of a small woodland creature, but also why I can rattle off a list of favorite ghosts and ghouls like they're important historical figures.
